title: Seatbelt block → training video → sensor fault
steps: Login as leo / operator123 on vehicle #3 (VITE_VEHICLE_ID=3).
Set cockpit seatbelt to UNFASTENED, press Start Task → gate blocks and plays the seatbelt training video.
Leave it >60s → status flips to SENSOR FAULT and the supervisor is notified (admin dashboard alert + incident).

title: Risk check suggests suspension
steps: Login as maya on vehicle #1, choose Zone C - Ridge (fallback weather: 58 km/h wind, 40 m visibility).
Prepare task → LightGBM estimate shown, risk check returns wind/visibility/moisture breaches → Suspend suggested.

title: 3 unresolved anomaly alerts → admin escalation + incident
steps: Login as raj on vehicle #2, start a Hauling task with demo scenario 'escalation'.
Simulated telemetry drifts into high idling / high fuel / low cycles → z-score + Isolation Forest flag anomalies every check.
Do not resolve them: after the 3rd unresolved alert the admin dashboard receives an escalation and an incident is auto-created.
